narrateur.description: Homme, la cinquantaine, voix grave et chaleureuse, ton de conteur, légèrement mystérieux.
narrateur.prompt_voice_design: A warm, deep French male voice in his fifties, native French speaker from France, calm storyteller tone with a hint of mystery, clear diction, like the narrator of a detective audio drama.

helene.description: Femme de 58 ans, bourgeoise, voix posée mais fragile, au bord des larmes.
helene.prompt_voice_design: A refined French woman in her late fifties, native speaker from France, elegant upper-class accent, soft and composed voice that trembles slightly with emotion, as if hiding something.

lucas.description: Jeune homme de 24 ans, simple et sincère, un peu nerveux.
lucas.prompt_voice_design: A young French man in his mid twenties, native speaker from rural Normandy, friendly and simple, a bit nervous and fast-talking, honest and slightly shy.

camille.description: Femme de 31 ans, énergique, inquiète, très attachée à sa jument.
camille.prompt_voice_design: A French woman in her early thirties, native speaker from France, energetic and sincere, worried and emotional, warm voice, sporty and determined.

victoire.description: Femme de 27 ans, aristocrate, hautaine et ironique.
victoire.prompt_voice_design: A young aristocratic French woman in her late twenties, native speaker from Paris, haughty, ironic and condescending, crisp posh diction, slightly bored tone.

antoine.description: Homme de 33 ans, nonchalant et sarcastique, voix un peu rauque de lendemain de fête.
antoine.prompt_voice_design: A French man in his early thirties, native speaker from France, nonchalant and sarcastic, slightly hoarse voice as if he partied all night, lazy and defensive tone.

delorme.description: Homme de 52 ans, voix rocailleuse, bonhomme mais roublard.
delorme.prompt_voice_design: A French man in his early fifties, native speaker from France, gravelly voice, jovial horse trader, a bit sly and smooth-talking, confident.

papy_marcel.description: Vieil homme de 80 ans, accent normand, malicieux et bienveillant.
papy_marcel.prompt_voice_design: An old French man around eighty, native speaker with a light rural Normandy accent, mischievous and kind grandfather, slow, amused and warm, slightly raspy.

gendarme.description: Homme de 45 ans, voix neutre et professionnelle, comme au téléphone.
gendarme.prompt_voice_design: A French police officer in his mid forties, native speaker from France, neutral, efficient and professional tone, speaking clearly as if on the phone.

commentateur.description: Homme de 40 ans, commentateur de course enthousiaste et un peu cabotin.
commentateur.prompt_voice_design: An enthusiastic French horse racing commentator in his forties, native speaker from France, fast, excited and theatrical, like a live sports broadcast.

porteur.nom: Le porteur de journaux (témoin anonyme, au casque)
porteur.description: Homme d'une quarantaine d'années, voix basse et inquiète, parle vite comme au téléphone.
porteur.prompt_voice_design: A French man in his forties, native speaker from Normandy, nervous and hushed voice, speaking quickly and quietly on a phone call at night, worried about getting involved.
